items.statement: The submitted calculation validates the neutral singlet Pd2Cl6 geometry and preserves system identity before interpreting XES.
items.expected: A geometry validation is documented and Pd–Pd plus six nearest Pd–Cl distances are reported for the spectrum geometry; the calculation uses charge 0 and multiplicity 1.

items.statement: The spectrum has transition-level provenance and reproducible broadening.
items.expected: Individual transition energies, intensities and orbital character are retained, and the submitted curve is regenerated from them using a declared broadening treatment; raw and aligned energies remain distinguishable.

items.statement: Pd2Cl6 has a broad, intense lower-energy shoulder centered near 3170 eV after defensible alignment.
items.expected: A distinct lower-energy shoulder is present with center approximately 3170 eV and is broader/more intense than a single weak satellite interpretation would imply.

items.statement: The shoulder is composed of several intense transitions with substantial Pd d contribution and Pd–Cl/Cl-valence involvement.
items.expected: Multiple supporting transition IDs span roughly 3167–3171 eV after alignment and their orbital evidence supports several Pd–Cl interactions rather than one isolated transition.
